annotations.title: Find a published Chief Bitcoin Officer answer

description: Searches Chief Bitcoin Officer's published answers and returns up to five, word for word as the site publishes them, best first, each with its page url (including a stable answer anchor where the page has one). Only approved published content is returned. Quote the answer text word for word. An empty answers list means no published answer matches: check noMatch for the explanation, and handoff when the question belongs on a sister site or a same-site tool. A handoff is never a published answer from this site and never includes another brand's answer text. Deterministic; no model.

query.description: Plain-language question or keywords to look up in Chief Bitcoin Officer's published answers. Up to 200 characters.
